# Wenger Performance Solutions

> > Performance venue solutions including theatre rigging, active acoustics (Transcend), staging systems, and safety resources from Wenger and J.R. Clancy.

Wenger Performance Solutions provides comprehensive technical solutions for performance venues, combining J.R. Clancy's theatrical rigging expertise with Wenger's innovative acoustic systems like Transcend. The site features project profiles, safety resources including RigSafe Day materials, and educational content for theatre professionals and educators.

## Key Topics

- Transcend Active Acoustic System
- Theatre rigging and stage machinery
- J.R. Clancy rigging systems
- Performance venue acoustics
- RigSafe Day and safety resources
- StageTek staging and risers
- ANSI rigging safety standards
- ETCP certification
- Acoustic shells and canopies
- USITT technical theatre
- Venue renovation and installation
- Active and passive acoustic solutions
- Choral risers and flexible staging
- Theatre safety inspections

## Safety Resources & Technical Standards

- [Scary Rigging Photos - Value of Rigging System Inspections](https://performance.wengercorp.com/rigging-system-inspections): Theatre rigging safety inspection importance with ANSI standards & ETCP cert
- [Celebrating RigSafe Day with FREE Resources](https://performance.wengercorp.com/celebrating-rigsafe-day-with-free-resources): RigSafe Day celebration with free downloadable theatre rigging safety posters
- [USITT 2026 Presentations](https://performance.wengercorp.com/usitt-2026-presentations): USITT 2026 conference presentations on stage machinery and rigging safety

- [Featured Facility: Xcel Energy Center, St. Paul, MN](https://performance.wengercorp.com/featured-facility-xcel-energy-center-st-paul-mn): Xcel Energy Center arena transformation with Strata staging for charity gala
